claude_proposed_widenings.name: UseCountCap.ability_modifier
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Nature's Veil use count is Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). Existing UseCountCap only supports fixed integer or threshold_tiers keyed on class level. An ability-score-derived cap is a distinct shape with no existing representation.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once)

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect.apply_condition
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Nature's Veil grants the Invisible condition to self until end of next turn. ClassFeatureEffect only covers grant_extra_action and heal_hp. An apply_condition variant (target=self, condition, duration) is required. The v4 atom apply_condition exists; only the surface ClassFeatureEffect union is missing it.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can give yourself the Invisible condition until the end of your next turn

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Condition.invisible
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Condition is currently a single-value union ('prone'). The Invisible condition is a standard SRD condition needed here and will recur across many stealth/illusion features.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can give yourself the Invisible condition
